title: Alexs Caves nonflammable
description: replaces oak in underground cabins with nonflammable materials from other mods
body:
This datapack simply replaces oak wood in underground cabins from Alex's Caves with petrified wood from Sully's mod and copper bars from caverns and chasms for aesthetics, mod integration and most importantly safety of the structure when it generates near lava.

Required mods:
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/sullysmod](https://modrinth.com/mod/sullysmod)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/woodworks](https://modrinth.com/mod/woodworks)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat)
